gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-puritan: Outrun Future draws every letter as a flat, wide-set outline of unvarying thickness, a bold synthwave signature that you could trace with a finger. Puritan softens it with rounded sans forms and generous counters.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-questrial: Neon-era swagger, laid out in wide, even outlines by Outrun Future, with short ascenders and a big x-height. Questrial's open, tall-bodied sans-serif lettering gives it room to breathe.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-radio-canada: Outrun Future sets a wide-spaced, synthwave outline with a large x-height and short ascenders, all in one constant stroke. Radio Canada, a plain sans, does the quieter job, with full, tall curves that stay open at every end.

Radio Canada Big fills the line with a tall x-height and a monoline skeleton, its terminals finishing well clear of each stem. Outrun Future brings the wide-set synthwave outline above it, so a long passage below reads smoothly while the heading keeps its swagger.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-readex-pro: Outrun Future is wide-set and outlined in a constant line, with a large x-height and short ascenders that feel distinctly synthwave. Readex Pro then keeps a steady weight from word to word, with broad gaps at the terminals, so a long passage goes down easily.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-roboto:
Roboto brings generous round letters and a low-key presence.

Outrun Future, with its straight-edged, constant strokes and wide spacing, earns its keep when it runs big and short, where that synthwave outline can show off.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-ruda: A single constant-width outline, wide-set and synthwave, is what defines Outrun Future, with its large x-height and short ascenders. Ruda goes the other way, a wire-like monoline sans-serif with wide-mouthed rounds that suit screen reading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-saira: Spaghetti-thin lines in wide-set letters make Outrun Future look like a neon sign. Saira's see-through s and tall rounded letters in sans-serif form handle the plain reading work.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sarpanch: Steel-cable outlines, wide and unshaded, make Outrun Future look like a synthwave poster. Sarpanch's open-mouthed e and compact lines in sans-serif form mean its size can stay modest while the heading carries the volume.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-schibsted-gr: Schibsted Grotesk reads open and friendly, with big-bowled e and a shapes and terminals that never close in. Outrun Future threads a single wide-set synthwave line above it, giving the page a bold top and a welcoming base.
